title: Design System: Five Nights at the Circus

display.purpose: Screen titles (Rye; Kelly Slab in Russian).

headline.purpose: Empty-state line; the picked habit in the detail pane.

title-large.purpose: A part's name in its detail.

body.purpose: Habit metadata, helper and reward text.

label.purpose: The nameplate and group labels, tracked caps.

numeral.purpose: Balances, levels and counters, in Rye.

shadows.name: bulb-halo
shadows.value: radial-gradient(bulb-glow 55% -> transparent, radius 2.1x bulb; up to 3.4x while fresh)
shadows.purpose: A lit bulb; the only glow on a slot.

shadows.name: card-lit-edge
shadows.value: 1.5dp bulb-glow at 90% over a 6dp bulb-glow haze at 25%, 12dp corners

shadows.name: spotlight
shadows.value: cone light 8%->26% vertical; pool radial 42%; vignette black 0/45/78/92% at 0/0.3/0.6/1
shadows.purpose: The one light in each room; everything else dark.

motion.name: bulb-buzz-on
motion.value: 700ms, two flickers at partial power then hold

motion.name: fresh-flare
motion.value: sin(t/260ms) pulse, held until the screen is left

motion.name: sign-ignite
motion.purpose: A just-completed sign's bloom and chase.

motion.name: swag-chase
motion.purpose: The marquee swag over the signs.

motion.name: fail-negative
motion.purpose: A smashed bulb; never with animations off.

motion.name: frame-clock
motion.value: one clock; t = 0 freezes every loop
motion.purpose: Animator duration scale 0 stills the ring.

sound.name: sfx_done
sound.value: bulb buzz, one flicker, filament tink, calliope note

sound.name: sfx_skip
sound.value: bulb squeaked out of its socket

sound.name: sfx_fail
sound.value: glass smash, servo screech into static

breakpoints.name: scene
breakpoints.value: 1000x900 scene; x 40..960, y 120..880 always shown; crop to x 60..940 when narrow

narrative.overview:
A circus tent after close. The show is long over and the animatronics are still awake. The ground is plum-black canvas, and the only light in the room is bulb amber: the bulbs on each habit's sign, the one spotlight on the ring box, the gauges, and the Done button. Everything else stays in the dark. Each habit is a marquee sign. Done lights a bulb that buzzes on, flickering twice before it holds. When every bulb on a sign is lit, its border lights chase and the animatronic's eyes flare.

The world is drawn, not photographed. Every figure, room and prop is vector art painted from Inks.kt roles over a 400 x 520 robot space and a 1000 x 900 ring scene. The art is inspired by the classic and withered animatronics and Sister Location's circus, but no game assets are copied. Tent red and cream are materials (the drum stripes, the riser skirt, the valance and the calliope). They never act as signals. The interface around the ring is quiet: plum cards, cream text, one amber action per card.

Density and structure are the same as the workshop flavour, with the same screens, breakpoints and rhythm. The circus changes only colour, faces, icons, art, words and sound.
keyCharacteristics: Plum-black tonal ladder (rail < ground < card < raised) with cream text.
Bulb amber is the single light and the single action colour.
Habit slots are bulbs, and each state has its own form: lit, dark, unscrewed, smashed.
Rye poster wood type for titles and numerals, with Manrope for everything read.
One spotlight. Outside its cone the ring falls to near-black.
A Fail flips the ring to its negative for one frame, under camera static.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: In the interface, amber is the only colour that glows or invites a press. Done is the one amber fill on a card, and every glow uses bulb-glow.

rules.name: The Tent Is Material Rule
rules.body: Tent red and cream stripe the drum, the riser, the valance and the calliope. They never mark state, never fill a control, and never colour text.

rules.name: The Pink Means Tokens Rule
rules.body: In the interface chrome, pink appears only on Faz-Tokens. Pink in the art (bows, blush, pom-poms, the Circus Gallery's neon) belongs to the costumes and rooms and is allowed.

rules.name: The Poster Face Is For Signs Rule
rules.body: Rye sets only titles and numbers, never a sentence. Anything read in full is Manrope.

rules.name: The Cyrillic Swap Rule
rules.body: When the language is Russian, every Rye role changes to Kelly Slab. The swap is never left to a system fallback.

rules.name: The One Spotlight Rule
rules.body: Each room has exactly one light colour (Center Ring amber, Parts & Service sick green #B8F0A0, Pirate Cove violet #B48CFF, Show Stage warm white #FFE3B0, Circus Gallery pink #FF6FA3). It feeds the spotlight and the marquee swag. Everything outside the cone stays dark.

dos: Do keep bulb amber (bulb-amber, bulb-glow) as the only light and the only action colour in the interface. Use one amber Done per card.
Do draw every slot as a marquee bulb in one of its four forms, so state is legible without colour.
Do set titles and numbers in Rye (Kelly Slab in Russian) and everything read in Manrope.
Do keep the stage dark outside the room's one spotlight, using one light colour per room.
Do let a fresh bulb keep its flare until the screen is left, and let a fully lit sign chase its border lights.
Do freeze every loop, the buzz-on and the negative-flash when the animator duration scale is 0.
Do use the circus's word overlay (Tickets, Faz-Tokens, Acts, Night Log, Animatronic, smashed) in EN, PT-PT and RU.
donts: Don't use tent red or cream stripe as a signal, a control fill or a text colour. They are canvas and wood.
Don't put pink in the interface chrome for anything but Faz-Tokens, or coral for anything but a smashed bulb and a destructive action.
Don't set sentences, labels or buttons in Rye.
Don't light the stage evenly. The scene is one spotlight cut out of the dark, not a lit dashboard of glow rings.
Don't copy game sprites, screenshots or audio. Every animatronic, room and sound is original.
Don't change the diary's papers or inks for the circus. They are owner-pinned and shared with the workshop.
